rationale: The nine isolated frames show various dough-handling moments but do not identify the start and end of either compared activity. evidence_refs: frames 450.000-1620.000s: intermittent dough, bowl and workspace views without activity boundaries
frame 3825.000s: bakery/oven area, not a demonstrated endpoint of continuous mixer cleaning
